prTitle: FIX: proper handling of group memberships
head: 060cda77729cb1c4a827560e09e89a7b22078ba9

prOriginalConhecido.nota: No upstream PR: the benchmark head 060cda77 (Régis Hanol, 'FIX: proper handling of group memberships') was committed directly to master on 2015-01-05 and is an ancestor of main (compare = ahead); /commits/<sha>/pulls is empty. The merged code is the benchmark head itself.

tps.bug: Group member pagination is off by one when user_count is a multiple of limit: Next moves to offset == user_count and shows an empty page.
tps.evidenciaOpus: admin-group.js.es6:13 computes totalPages as floor(user_count/limit)+1, so with 100 members and limit 50 it is 3; at offset 50 showingLast is false and next (line 33) sets offset min(100,100)=100, loading an empty page. The pagination added by this PR lets the admin step onto a page with no members.
tps.evidenciaAstra: The newly added pagination in app/assets/javascripts/admin/controllers/admin-group.js.es6:13 calculates three pages for 100 members at limit 50, so showingLast remains false at offset 50 and next advances to offset 100 at line 33. app/controllers/groups_controller.rb:26 applies that offset directly, returning an empty page; the proposed clamp also requires correcting totalPages.
